sourceSentences: When combining your W with your cage, don't always stun them and cast the W on the actual stun. Try to cast it slightly in front of them.
So, launch your cage, use Q and W on cooldown, and then your ultimate to secure high-priority kills.
Voilà ZQ R one shot pas de counter play.
il l'enferme elle peut pas jouer il la queue il la R et c'est fini
Veigar sends a primordial burst at the target enemy champion that deals magic damage, increased by target's missing health
Now if you need the extra damage from your QR, then of course you do QR.
Un petit QR, ça va, il se passe très bien.
Quand on commence à la cage, tu vois, en deuxième, on met directement flash que cage. Ils sont enfermés. Un petit QR
Typically, this is done with like a protobelt and shurelya's type of build, especially if you have flash up. You can go for engages with your cage.
Veigar generates a stack of Phenomenal Evil for each enemy champion hit by his abilities
Veigar's abilities do not have to deal damage nor affect their targets to grant a stack.

track the passive if it goes up when you're casting abilities in fog. For example, if you stun someone in a bush or you cast a Q in a bush like here. Now I see I got one AP so I know someone is in that bush.
An enemy can be affected by Event Horizon only once every 4.5 seconds.
Units that negate the stun will still count as passing through the edges. They will become immune to the effects of Event Horizon for the period even after negating them.
Displacement immune enemies will still be stunned, but not knocked down.
Event Horizon may fail to catch enemies that move very quickly through the boundary distance.
The delay starts at the beginning of the cast time. If Veigar dies during the cast time, Dark Matter will still successfully fall from the sky.
strikes the target location after a delay, granting sight of the area during the delay
Veigar blasts a dark bolt in the target direction that deals magic damage to the first two enemies hit.
If this kills an enemy, it generates 1 stack of Phenomenal Evil Power, tripled against large minions and monsters.
Dark Matter's cooldown is reduced based on stacks of Phenomenal Evil Power.
